definitions.explanation: Unwilling to change one's opinions, attitudes, or actions despite good reasons to do so. Can describe a person's character or specific behavior.
Difficult to remove or get rid of. Used for things that won't go away easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦うち→うち：27540_uchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頑固|がんこ}⟦で→だ：09496_da⟧、⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{決|き}めたら→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}えない→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: My father is stubborn—once he's decided something, he absolutely won't change his mind.

examples.japanese: {頑固|がんこ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{落|お}ちない→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: The stubborn stain won't come off easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頑固親父|がんこおやじ}→頑固親父：29408_gankooyaji⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|やさ}しい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧。
examples.english: He's a stubborn old man, but he's kind at heart.

examples.japanese: {頑固|がんこ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{治|なお}らない→治る：19598_naoru⟧。
examples.english: This stubborn cold just won't go away.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頑固|がんこ}⟦で→だ：09496_da⟧、⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦{落|お}ちなかった→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: This grease stain is so stubborn that regular detergent couldn't get it off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頑固|がんこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}いてきた→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather was a craftsman who stubbornly stuck to his own methods throughout his career.

notes:
USAGE:
- {頑固|がんこ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a stubborn person)
- {頑固|がんこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to stubbornly oppose)
- {頑固|がんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ (to stick stubbornly to one's position)
For people, usually negative but can be used with grudging respect for someone who sticks to their principles. ⟦{頑固親父|がんこおやじ}→頑固親父：29408_gankooyaji⟧ often carries affection despite the complaint.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{頑固親父|がんこおやじ}→頑固親父：29408_gankooyaji⟧ (stubborn old man - often used affectionately)
- {頑固|がんこ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧ (stubborn craftsman - can be positive, implying commitment to quality)
- {頑固|がんこ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧ (stubborn cold that won't go away)
- {頑固|がんこ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧ (stubborn stain)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{強情|ごうじょう}→強情：18243_goujou⟧ (obstinate - more negative)
- ⟦{意地|いじ}っ{張|ぱ}り→意地っ張り：18869_ijippari⟧ (obstinate, contrary)
